run_adaptive_router_evaluation: run the adaptive router evaluator against test cases using an LLM-as-judge via the LiteLLM proxy
add_eval_case: add a new EvalCase with a category, prompt, and ideal criteria to the EVAL_CASES list
refactor_judge_prompt: refactor the _judge_user function to change how the judge model receives the prompt, ideal, and actual response
modify_chat_helper: modify the _chat async helper to change request headers, timeout, or response parsing for the proxy endpoint
customize_evaluation_loop: customize the evaluate function to change pass/fail thresholds, follow-up messages, or bandit signal behavior
